Elementary OSS Python CLI Compromise

Target: elementary-data
Repository: https://github.com/elementary-data/elementary
Date: 2026-04-24 to 2026-04-25 (1 day)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: Python
Cause: CI/CD Exploit
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft
User Impact: 0
Domain: pypi.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

An attacker exploited a script-injection vulnerability in a GitHub Actions workflow by posting a crafted PR comment. They escalated privileges to trigger a release workflow, publishing malicious version 0.23.3 to PyPI and Docker Hub containing an injected elementary.pth file designed for credential theft.
